user_input: Who is the current CEO of Setopia Co., Ltd.?
reference: The current CEO of Setopia Co., Ltd. is Sang-cheol Seo.

user_input: What was the company name of Setopia Co., Ltd. before August 1, 2022?
reference: It was Midas AI Co., Ltd.

user_input: When was the merger date for Setopia Co., Ltd.'s absorption merger of Jaison & Company Co., Ltd.?
reference: The merger date was January 2, 2023.

user_input: What is the main product of Setopia's steel business, and what is its domestic market share?
reference: The main product is STS 201, and it holds the number one domestic market share at approximately 30-40%.

user_input: The distribution business Setopia entered into involved an exclusive domestic distributorship contract for which brand's products?
reference: It was an exclusive domestic distributorship contract for the global e-cigarette brand ELFBAR.

user_input: Who was the auditor for the 11th fiscal period (current semi-annual) audit report, and what was the audit opinion?
reference: The auditor was Samil PwC, and the audit opinion was a 'Disclaimer of Opinion'.

user_input: What happened to the contract for the acquisition of tangible assets (land and building) from SA Corporation Co., Ltd. dated January 20, 2025?
reference: The contract was terminated on January 20, 2025.

user_input: What was the ratio of the capital reduction without refund (gratis reduction) implemented on February 12, 2025?
reference: A 5-to-1 capital reduction was completed.

user_input: Who is the largest shareholder of Setopia Co., Ltd., and what is their stake as of June 30, 2025?
reference: The largest shareholder is SA Corporation Co., Ltd., with a 6.89% stake.

user_input: How much was the fine imposed on Setopia Co., Ltd. by the Securities and Futures Commission on March 12, 2025?
reference: A fine of 270 million KRW was imposed related to the overstatement of financial assets and liabilities.

user_input: How did Setopia's main business change after the merger with Jaison & Company Co., Ltd. on January 2, 2023?
reference: The main business changed from 'Software consulting, development, and supply' to 'Primary steel manufacturing and wholesale'.

user_input: What is the status of Setopia's distribution business (e-cigarettes) after 2024, and why?
reference: Although the imported volume was sold out within 2024, the company is not making additional imports and has no future plans to do so due to rapid market trend changes and low profitability.

user_input: How have Setopia's plans for its rare earth business been modified?
reference: Setopia plans to remain only as the parent company of its subsidiary, GCM Co., Ltd., which will independently operate the business. Setopia itself does not plan to proceed directly with the business any further.

user_input: What is the current status of the cannabis business that was operated by Setopia's US subsidiary, MIM USA, INC?
reference: On April 25, 2025, MIM USA, INC sold its entire stake in its subsidiary, Melrose Facility Management, LLC, and is not conducting the cannabis business as of the report submission date.

user_input: Why did Setopia not proceed with the 'Waste Management Business' and 'Pet Business' that were added as business purposes at the EGM on January 27, 2023?
reference: The waste management business was deemed unsuitable after a review of business feasibility, including permits and regulations. The pet business was tentatively put on hold as other new businesses were prioritized.

user_input: Who were the external auditors for the 9th, 10th, and 11th (current semi-annual) fiscal periods, and what were their respective audit opinions?
reference: The company received a 'Disclaimer of Opinion' for three consecutive periods: 9th Period (E-Chon accounting firm, Disclaimer), 10th Period (E-Chon accounting firm, Disclaimer), and 11th Semi-annual Period (Samil PwC, Disclaimer).

user_input: What were the two main reasons cited by the auditor for issuing a disclaimer of opinion for the 11th current semi-annual period?
reference: (1) Uncertainty regarding the going concern (due to net loss, accumulated deficit, and current liabilities exceeding current assets) and (2) Limitations on major review procedures.

user_input: As a synergy effect from the Jaison & Company acquisition, what was Setopia's 2023 revenue forecast for the steel business, and what was the actual result?
reference: The revenue forecast for 2023 was 107,078 million KRW, but the actual result was 98,081 million KRW.

user_input: What was the primary reason for the 2024 steel business performance falling short of the forecast after the Jaison & Company merger?
reference: It was due to the suspension of stock trading on April 4, 2024, following a disclaimer of audit opinion, which led to reduced product purchases resulting from decreased transactions with financial institutions and lower credit limits.

user_input: As of the end of the 11th semi-annual period (June 30, 2025), what is Setopia's accumulated deficit, and what is the assessment of its ability to continue as a going concern?
reference: The accumulated deficit is 139,813 million KRW. This situation indicates the existence of significant uncertainty that raises substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern.

user_input: On March 31, 2025, when Setopia rescinded the stock acquisition agreements for KCM Industry Co., Ltd. and NS-World Co., Ltd., how were the convertible bonds (18th and 20th) that had been paid as consideration handled?
reference: The company returned all the acquired shares to the counterparties and received back the full amount of the bonds (18th CB 2.0B KRW, 20th CB 2.0B KRW) that had been paid.

user_input: According to Setopia's consolidated statement of financial position as of the 11th semi-annual period end (2025.06.30), what are the total current assets and total current liabilities?
reference: Total current assets are 9,071,420,676 KRW, and total current liabilities are 17,387,059,424 KRW.

user_input: What agenda items were approved at Setopia's Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on January 27, 2025?
reference: The appointments of directors (Internal Director Nam Yoon-young, Outside Directors Nam Sang-shin and Jo Chan-hwi) and the agenda for capital reduction without refund were approved as proposed.

user_input: As of June 30, 2025, how many minority shareholders does Setopia have, and what percentage of the total outstanding shares do they hold?
reference: There are 17,952 minority shareholders, holding 76.89% of the total outstanding shares.

user_input: Why has trading of Setopia's stock been suspended since April 4, 2024?
reference: Trading was suspended on April 4, 2024, due to a 'Disclaimer of Opinion' (resulting from limitations on audit scope and going concern uncertainty) in the auditor's report for the 2023 (10th) fiscal year.

user_input: What is Stainless Steel, as handled by Setopia's steel business?
reference: Stainless steel is an alloy steel made by adding a significant amount of chromium (usually 12% or more) to iron (Fe) to make it resistant to rust. It may also contain small amounts of carbon, nickel, silicon, and manganese as needed.

user_input: In Setopia's rare earth business, what is a 'Neodymium permanent magnet (NdFeB)' and why is it important?
reference: It is a magnet developed in 1983 that has the strongest magnetic force of any magnet developed to date. It is important because it is used as a core material in high-tech industries such as EV drive motors, wind power turbines, and robots.

user_input: As of June 30, 2025, how many consolidated subsidiaries does Setopia have, and what are their names?
reference: There are four subsidiaries in total: iHOPCBD Co., Ltd., MIM USA, INC, GCM Co., Ltd., and GCM VINA.

user_input: What was the basis for Setopia calculating the merger ratio as 1:0 for the merger with Jaison & Company?
reference: It was because Setopia, the merging company, already owned 100% of the shares of Jaison & Company, the merged company, and it was a merger without capital increase (no new shares were issued).

user_input: What are the names of the three patents held by Setopia as of June 30, 2025?
reference: Method for detecting atypical malicious code using process behavior prediction techniques and its system', 'Apparatus and method for detecting abnormal traffic', and 'Apparatus and method for detecting dynamic link libraries inserted by malicious code'.
